strengthLevels.title: Strength levels
strengthLevels.otherNote: Shown on both the men's and women's scales, because no single table fits.
strengthLevels.addWeighIn: Add a weigh-in to see strength levels.
strengthLevels.sourceNote: Levels compare your estimated 1RM with your body weight. They are a Musclog rule of thumb, checked against public powerlifting results from OpenPowerlifting.
